moments.action: Lynn sits mid-row in the exam hall, eyes shut over her paper. The angle swings behind her to the hall clock at 10:42:11, and the doorway ahead fades through into a dark room with an upright piano.
Extreme close-ups of Lynn's sweating brow and tight face; an insert shows a pencilled letter string C B A A D on blank paper. She is back upright in the stacks, writing steadily.
Cuts alternate between Lynn at the lamplit piano and Lynn bent over her desk in the hall. The run ends on the paper, where the letter string has grown to D P B C A D B D.
Lynn frowns down at her sheet, then her fingers start drumming the desktop; the cut matches them to hands running real piano keys and back to the silent tapping on the exam paper.
Lynn's sweat-sheened profile in the piano room, then upright in the stacks reading her sheet; an insert shows answer bubbles already shaded in, and she ends breathing hard, mouth open.

A held wide of Lynn's back at the upright piano, window light behind her, breaks into a whip-pan blur and lands on the proctor in the cream blazer planted in the hall doorway, hands on hips, watching.
The intercut speeds up: blurred piano playing, Lynn writing at her desk, filled C and D bubbles, fingers on keys. It ends tight on her hand tapping in the foreground with her face soft behind it.
A new location: a dim print works full of old presses. A phone left on a desk lights up with an incoming call from 0840126470, and the cut goes outside to the shop's Thai signboard.
A long static hold on a car's rear window carrying a handwritten paper advert; the number on it, 084-012-6470, is the one that just rang at the print shop.
A hand holds a phone reading 6:58, Sat Oct 8; two students compare their screens in a packed hall; the camera pans a rank of waiting motorbike taxis and settles on a wall clock ticking to 6:59.
Back in the exam hall the clock has run to 10:57:59. The proctor stares straight down the room, and Lynn sits with her eyes closed, face damp and still.
Lynn's hand sweeps across the page of pencilled letters and the camera pushes past it to the next section heading printed in the booklet: Essay.
